Thanks for the demo earlier — FinHealth is interested in moving forward but our security and procurement teams need a few items before we can start a security review loop:

Hi Daniel — thanks for reaching out. Attaching a redacted pen test summary and our vulnerability management policy for your review (attachments: redwood_pen_test_summary_v2.pdf, redwood_vuln_management_policy.pdf).

Summary highlights (TL;DR):
- Pen test: External pentest completed 2026-06; no critical findings affecting production confidentiality or integrity. Redacted report included.
- Vulnerability management: Weekly internal automated scanning (SCA and container image scanning) plus monthly authenticated scans and quarterly external penetration tests.
- Remediation SLAs (engineered triage + deployment cadence): 
  - Critical: acknowledge within 4 hours; mitigation deployment target within 72 hours (hotfix path)
  - High: acknowledge within 24 hours; fix within 7 business days
  - Medium: fix within 30 calendar days
  - Low: scheduled in backlog 
- Disclosure: We follow coordinated disclosure for external researchers and will provide redacted summaries to customers on request. Responsible disclosure policy linked in document.

If you prefer we can complete your questionnaire directly — attach it and I will assign to our security operations engineer to fill in.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_pen_test_summary_v2.pdf (redacted), redwood_vuln_management_policy.pdf

Thanks Rishi — that helps a lot. A couple quick clarifications before we kick off procurement:

1) For remediation SLAs, can you confirm whether the Critical "72 hours" is calendar or business hours? Our procurement needs that spelled out for the SOW.
2) Scanning cadence: you mentioned weekly automated and monthly authenticated scans — do you have a schedule we can reference (day/time) and do you provide exportable scan reports (PDF/CSV) for our audit evidence?
3) Disclosure: if we discover a vulnerability in our environment that affects our tenant, how does coordinated disclosure to customers work (do you notify customers proactively, and what timeline)?

Also attaching our vendor security questionnaire (FinHealth_Vendor_Q_2026.pdf) — can you confirm who will own filling this out and estimated turnaround?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Alice
Procurement Lead, FinHealth

Attached: FinHealth_Vendor_Q_2026.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Morgan <alice@finhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@finhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2026 15:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro / Redwood demo follow-up — security materials

Hi Alice — quick answers inline below.

1) Critical SLA: 72 hours is calendar hours; for multi-day incidents we commit to an initial mitigation or workaround within 72 calendar hours and continuous updates until fully resolved. We can capture calendar-hours vs business-hours in the SOW if you prefer business-hours for contract language.

2) Scanning cadence & reports:
   - Weekly automated vulnerability scans run every Monday at 02:00 UTC (internal schedule) and generate an exportable CSV and PDF report.
   - Monthly authenticated scans run on the first Tuesday of each month; external pentests are scheduled quarterly.
   - We will provide exportable scan reports for audit evidence; we can add a scheduled share to a secure link for FinHealth with read-only access.

3) Disclosure workflow if FinHealth reports an issue affecting your tenant:
   - Triage within 4 hours (acknowledgement)
   - Escalation to engineering and engagement of customer success within 8 hours
   - Notification to affected customers within 24 hours with remediation ETA if the issue impacts confidentiality or availability.
   - Post-incident summary with root cause and remediation timeline shared within 7 business days.

Questionnaire: Marissa — I can own completion of the FinHealth_Vendor_Q_2026.pdf. ETA: I will populate answers and return a draft within 3 business days (by Tue 2026-09-07). If there are questions that require legal/security approval I will flag them early.

Let me know if you'd like us to provision a temporary read-only link to the weekly report exports for your compliance team.

Thanks,
Rishi
